How the inputs work

  • Land area sets the size of every zone, the water per cycle and total yield.
  • Budget is compared with about Rs. 30,000 per acre of input cost. A tighter budget shifts area toward pulses, which need less fertilizer.
  • Soil type changes how fast moisture drains and the level that triggers irrigation.
  • Location sets the real current weather for that district (from Open-Meteo), which changes evaporation and rain in the model.

Use your MATLAB output

Export a CSV from MATLAB with day in the first column, soil moisture % in the second and an optional pump state (0 or 1) in the third. For example:

writematrix([t(:) moisture(:) pump(:)], "smartkrishi.csv")
